maharashtra.intro: Maharashtra has a rich artistic heritage shaped by tribal traditions, textiles, storytelling and skilled craftsmanship.

arts.name: Warli Art
arts.description: A distinctive folk painting tradition associated with the Warli community.

arts.name: Paithani
arts.description: A traditional handwoven textile known for intricate patterns and rich designs.

arts.name: Chitrakathi
arts.description: A traditional storytelling art associated with illustrated narrative panels.

arts.name: Sawantwadi Craft
arts.description: Traditional handcrafted wooden art associated with the Sawantwadi region.

arts.name: Kolhapuri Craft
arts.description: Traditional craftsmanship associated with the cultural heritage of Kolhapur.

rajasthan.intro: Rajasthan is known for vibrant colours, miniature paintings, decorative traditions, textiles and skilled handicrafts.

arts.name: Rajasthani Miniature Painting
arts.description: Detailed miniature painting traditions developed through several regional schools.

arts.name: Phad Painting
arts.description: A traditional narrative painting tradition used to tell stories through visual scenes.

arts.name: Mandana Art
arts.description: Decorative floor and wall art traditionally created during festivals and ceremonies.

arts.name: Blue Pottery
arts.description: A distinctive decorative pottery tradition strongly associated with Jaipur.

arts.name: Thewa Art
arts.description: A traditional decorative art involving intricate designs and craftsmanship.

bihar.intro: Bihar is home to remarkable folk and craft traditions that preserve stories, beliefs, nature and regional identity.

arts.name: Madhubani Art
arts.description: A richly patterned painting tradition from the Mithila region.

arts.name: Sujuni Embroidery
arts.description: A traditional textile embroidery practice using detailed stitched storytelling.

arts.name: Sikki Craft
arts.description: A traditional craft made using the golden-coloured Sikki grass.

arts.name: Tikuli Art
arts.description: A decorative painting tradition known for detailed designs and vibrant colours.

arts.name: Manjusha Art
arts.description: A traditional folk-art form associated with the Bhagalpur region.

west-bengal.intro: West Bengal has a diverse artistic heritage including scroll painting, embroidery, terracotta and metal craftsmanship.

arts.name: Pattachitra
arts.description: A traditional narrative painting tradition using detailed compositions and storytelling.

arts.name: Kalighat Painting
arts.description: A distinctive painting tradition that developed around the Kalighat area of Kolkata.

arts.name: Kantha Embroidery
arts.description: A traditional textile practice known for layered fabric and decorative stitching.

arts.name: Dokra Craft
arts.description: Traditional metal craft created using an ancient casting technique.

arts.name: Terracotta Art
arts.description: Clay-based artistic traditions particularly associated with temple and decorative art.
